root_cause_analysis.symptom: Page shows broken sidebar, empty timelines, stale Xi'an content, and grey-box phantom cards.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Multiple decoupled root causes share a meta-pattern: each prior iteration changed ONE side of the data↔renderer contract without updating the other side. (a) BUG-A/C: transportation.json injected location_short, but _inject_intra_routes overrode location_base used by sidebar grouping; (b) BUG-D: intra_routes built into kanban data but TimelineView never iterates it; (c) BUG-B: scope-out declared in plan-skeleton location strings but stale Xi'an POIs left in 4 sibling data files; (d) BUG-E: meal _options array built for kanban but TimelineView blindly iterates all options as parallel entries; (e) BUG-G: accommodation_jade slot added but Matilde 自行 placeholder still occupies primary accommodation slot and renders as phantom card.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — multi-iteration drift; no single commit identified. Recent auto-commits 4e90833 / c74b6a4 / 0231e17 / 99e1c7a / 3e08398 are likely cumulative
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Each iteration tackled a sub-problem in isolation: split_day shape, intra_routes for booked transports, accommodation_jade for Jade home, plan-skeleton scope-out. Each change landed without verifying end-to-end render.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Renderer treats data fields literally; never warns when a new field is unused or when a field's intended consumer differs from its actual consumer. No end-to-end QA gate. Lost trust accumulated.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Recent iterations 2026-04-26 → 2026-05-05 (per git auto-commits). User reported full-cluster failure on 2026-05-05 06:00.
observations: BUG-A inferred: transportation.json Day 4 has location_short='Datong → Chengdu' (Read of file); renderer line 612-613 sets merged.location_base = location_short; renderer line 1268 groups by location_base. (Source-code reading.)
BUG-A observed indirect: user screenshot IMG_1602 shows '大同 → 成都（玉林西路）' as sidebar group name — matches the predicted output of the inferred path.

BUG-B observed: bash extraction via Python json parse over meals.json Day 9-11 lists 9 stale Xi'an entries with their exact name_local strings — matches user IMG_1600/1601 screenshots verbatim ('郑记biangbiang面（钟楼店）', '永兴坊', etc.).

BUG-C observed indirect: IMG_1602 shows exactly '西安 (1 day)' and '北京（Jade）(2 days)' — matches inferred output.

BUG-D inferred: TimelineView at line 2891-2920 iterates day.transportation, day.meals, day.attractions, day.entertainment, day.shopping, day.cafe, day.travel_segments, day.accommodation; does NOT iterate day.intra_routes. transportation.json Day 6 has G5415/G8562 in intra_city_routes, which flow to merged.intra_routes (line 629), not consumed by TimelineView.
BUG-D observed indirect: IMG_1597 Day 6 timeline omits G5415/乐山大佛/G8562 — matches inferred output.
BUG-E inferred: line 716-757 builds meals[mealType+'_options'] with each alternative receiving time = primary.time. Line 2899-2906 (TimelineView) iterates _options and adds each as separate entry.
BUG-E observed indirect: IMG_1593 shows 3 dinner cards at same 17:51-19:25 slot — matches inferred output.
BUG-F observed: cache simulation script (Python) returns 7 in-scope POIs with no image_url AND no images.json cache hit.

BUG-G inferred + observed: accommodation.json Days 9-14 contain {name_local: '马蒂尔德西安住宿待定（自行安排）', image_url: '', cost: 0}; renderer line 992-1022 writes this unconditionally to merged.accommodation; user screenshots IMG_1600/1601 show empty grey accommodation cards on those days.
